title: Get your cold emails out of Outlook Junk with real placement tests
systemName: Your sending setup and placement tests

facts: Post: China-based custom manufacturer emailing EU manufacturing, engineering and product development companies.
Post: existing n8n, Google Sheets and Smartlead workflow researches sites and writes personalized emails.
Post: emails land in Spam/Junk, especially Microsoft 365 / Outlook; SPF, DKIM and DMARC pass.
Post: wants real test emails from the actual sending accounts to Microsoft 365 / Outlook and Gmail test inboxes, checking Inbox, Spam/Junk or rejected; not warm-up scores.
Post: neutral professional sending domains; Microsoft 365 preferred; own Smartlead login required.

scenes.title: A real test email, not a warm-up score.
scenes.caption: Every week, each sending mailbox emails your Outlook, Microsoft 365 and Gmail test inboxes, and n8n checks where it landed.
scenes.beat: This is the weekly placement test. n8n sends a real email from {{mailbox.address}} to three test inboxes, then reads back whether it landed in the Inbox, in Junk, or got rejected. In test {{test.id}} it hit Junk at Microsoft 365, so the mailbox is paused in Smartlead and the result goes to your Google Sheet.
details: Test {{test.id}}: Outlook Inbox, Microsoft 365 Junk, Gmail Inbox
The Smartlead step is an HTTP Request; the account login and endpoint are set up with you.
